name: Kimpton Kitalay Samui
positioning: Beachfront resort on Choengmon Beach in Koh Samui, blending contemporary design with traditional accents
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with a strong dining line-up
Families with children and guests travelling with pets

facts.text: The resort offers direct access to the white-sand Choengmon Beach, overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.
The resort blends contemporary design with traditional accents.
Dining venues are FishHouse, SHIO, Boho, SHADES and HOM, covering seafood, beach-inspired cocktails, coffee and modern Thai dishes.
FishHouse Restaurant & Bar is a beach-house-style restaurant specialising in seafood and fish.
Boho Thai Lifestyle Cafe is set in a botanically inspired gallery featuring local Thai arts, handicrafts and florals.
The resort has an oceanfront main swimming pool open to all guests.
Kitavaree Spa & Wellness is the on-site spa.
A complimentary cocktail hour is offered.
Nearby experiences include the island's gallery scene and tours of an independent rum distillery, a Thai micro farm and a fishing village.
Breakfast is free with the stay.

highlights.text: SHIO Japanese Dining & Sushi Bar serves premium fish flown in directly from Japan.
Accommodation is characterised by pattern and weave, with nautical hints in the villas alluding to the site once being a chief fisherman's home.
Pets are welcome, and their stay is complimentary whatever their size, weight or breed.
The resort has a 500-square-metre Kids Club.

considerations.text: There is no local area shuttle at the hotel, and an airport shuttle from Samui International Airport is not available.
WhataHotel notes the island location requires flight connections.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
